payload.purpose_context: Every Hubnot merge waits for a maintainer today, because automerge still requires per-proposal maintainer acceptances and its executors must be maintainers. This mission adds an opt-in rule mode whose standing acceptance is the signed policy amendment that adopted it. A non-maintainer executor can then merge proposals that satisfy the rule, every client and hn serve re-derive and verify that the rule was satisfied, and maintainers keep approving policy amendments and protected-check changes by hand.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let one maintainer-accepted policy amendment adopt an automerge rule that stands in for per-proposal maintainer acceptance, so a non-maintainer executor can merge eligible ordinary changes.

payload.rationale: The invocation delegates every decision to the specifying agent and forbids waiting. The brief scope items 1-7, its out-of-scope list, constraints and acceptance scenarios, plus design decisions D2-D4, are treated as the maintainer's discovery answers. D1 (pipeline requesters, commit 7a47e69) is already shipped and is not redone. Choices the brief leaves open are recorded as OQ-1 to OQ-11.

payload.final_answer: OQ-1: Policy validation rejects any automerge rule with acceptance rule when proposals.requiredApprovals is 0. A standing acceptance replaces the maintainer's per-proposal judgment, so at least one counting trusted approval for the exact candidate must remain. No rule-level threshold is added; the ordinary requiredApprovals applies.
payload.rationale: Agent-selected default under the maintainer's delegated non-interactive instruction, chosen for consistency with the Hubnot charter (fail closed on hostile input, immutable signed history, trust only from explicit policy) and the existing automerge and protected-check behavior. Recorded in spec.md as an open question for maintainer confirmation at spec review.

payload.final_answer: OQ-2: Under acceptance rule, a proposal author's own approval never counts toward the rule, even when proposals.allowAuthorApproval is true. This matches how designated protected-check approvals already exclude the author, and it is what makes cross-family review meaningful. Under acceptance maintainers, allowAuthorApproval keeps today's meaning.

payload.final_answer: OQ-3: acceptance accepts exactly the strings maintainers and rule; absence and an explicit maintainers are equivalent; null, empty and any other value are rejected. reviewers is optional; when present it lists 1-64 distinct full actor fingerprints, every one also in proposals.trustedReviewers, with at least proposals.requiredApprovals members. It narrows only which approvals count toward the rule. A current change request from any proposals.trustedReviewers actor still blocks. reviewers is allowed in both modes; under maintainers mode it is an execution-time restriction and the merge fact stays the existing acceptance fact.

The runtime refusals of policy amendments and protected-check changes remain for both modes.

payload.final_answer: OQ-6: Standing acceptance applies only when the policy at the actual target (local automerge) or at the destination tip (hn serve) has the same digest as the candidate's base policy. Otherwise the update is refused and the candidate must be revised. A policy amendment that removes or narrows a rule or an executing actor therefore stops pending rule merges of older-base candidates.

payload.final_answer: OQ-7: hn serve admits a protected-branch update under standing acceptance only through an advancement request that names the rule. The server evaluates the named rule from the base policy and the facts it holds, including current trusted change requests, current trusted pipeline failures and maintainer rejections, in addition to its existing protected-branch checks. The requesting mapped actor must be an executing actor of that rule, in place of the maintainer requirement, for that request only. A direct push or an advancement request without a rule still requires maintainer acceptances. New refusals use new stable reason codes.

They do not look for maintainer rejections, change requests or failures outside the evidence, because signed facts across chains have no delivery-order winner. Those vetoes block execution and hn serve advancement.
